key.name: last-page
key.description: The sidebar item that was selected when the window closed: a destination's key, or "playlist:ID" or "folder:ID" for one of the library's playlists or folders.

key.name: expanded-folders
key.description: The ids of the playlist folders shown open in the sidebar, their contents listed under them.

key.name: browser-command
key.description: The command that runs Google Chrome, the playback engine (it must be the real Chrome: it ships Widevine). When it is not on PATH, google-chrome-stable, google-chrome and /opt/google/chrome/chrome are tried.

key.name: engine-port
key.description: The port on 127.0.0.1 where the engine's Chrome listens for DevTools. The development build uses the port after this one (9229 by default) so it can run beside a release build; APPLE_MUSIC_PORT in the environment overrides both.

key.name: engine-headless
key.description: Whether Chrome runs without a window once signed in. Off, the Chrome window stays visible after signing in.

key.name: engine-autostart
key.description: Whether Chrome is started (headless) when the app starts and the account is signed in.

key.name: signed-in
key.description: Whether the engine's Chrome profile holds an Apple Music sign-in; set by signing in and cleared by signing out.

key.name: account-name
key.description: The name shown on the account button, read from the Apple Music page after signing in; empty when none could be read.

key.name: last-sync
key.summary: When the library was last synced
key.description: The time the library was last fetched from Apple Music in full, as an ISO 8601 timestamp; empty before the first sync.

key.name: sync-interval
key.description: The library is synced again when the app starts (or the engine comes up) and the last sync is older than this many hours. 0 syncs only when asked (Refresh Library).
